jobs.description:
Buscamos um(a) **Desenvolvedor Backend** para atuar em um squad multidisciplinar responsável pela construção de um novo produto digital vinculado a um cliente do segmento financeiro.

O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento dos **serviços, APIs, regras de negócio e integrações** que suportarão as aplicações mobile iOS e Android, incluindo a implementação da arquitetura necessária para suportar o conceito de **Server-Driven UI (SDUI)**.

  
  
  
  
**Responsabilidades e atribuições**  

**Principais responsabilidades**
--------------------------------

* Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend responsáveis pelo produto
* Construir APIs escaláveis, seguras e de alta disponibilidade para consumo pelas aplicações mobile.
* Implementar regras de negócio relacionadas a funcionalidades do produto.
* Implementar serviços responsáveis por fornecer configurações e estruturas necessárias para a estratégia de **Server-Driven UI**.
* Definir e evoluir contratos entre backend e aplicações mobile.
* Desenvolver serviços seguindo princípios de arquitetura modular e desacoplada.
* Implementar integrações com serviços e plataformas existentes no ecossistema do cliente
* Desenvolver mecanismos de autenticação, autorização e controle de acesso.
* Implementar tratamento de concorrência, idempotência e consistência das operações.
* Garantir rastreabilidade das operações realizadas pelos usuários.
* Implementar tratamento adequado de erros, exceções e indisponibilidades.
* Criar testes unitários, testes de integração e apoiar testes automatizados.

  + RBAC e controle de acesso.
  + Segurança de APIs.
  + Criptografia de dados em trânsito e em repouso.
  + Gestão de secrets e credenciais.
  + Secure Coding.

* Documentar funcionalidades, integrações e decisões técnicas.

* Vontade de aprender e de buscar qualidade de código, automação e melhoria de processos.

----------------------------------

* Experiência com monorepos (NX, Turborepo).
* Experiência com sistemas multi-tenant: isolamento de dados, RBAC e provisionamento por tenant.
* Experiência com integrações de mensageria e e-mail: WhatsApp Business API, Microsoft Graph.
* Experiência com Java/Spring e Hibernate.
* Experiência com mensageria e filas (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams).
* Conhecimento de Kubernetes, Helm e ingress controllers (Traefik, NGINX).
* Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade (InfluxDB, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Email & Communications Platform
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer, Email & Communications Platform (Software Engineer III)**

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team that owns our email and communications platform — the system responsible for delivering millions of marketing emails on behalf of our dealer network. You'll work across the full stack, building and scaling the infrastructure that powers campaigns, transactional messages, and automated communications that directly drive revenue for our customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. Our platform is in an active modernization phase. You'll be working in a mature codebase that serves real production traffic while incrementally upgrading architecture, tooling, and patterns. That means you need to be comfortable holding two things at once: keeping the lights on for a system dealers depend on today, and making deliberate progress toward where the platform needs to be tomorrow. You'll design and implement features end-to-end, from database schema and API design through to the UI that internal teams and dealers interact with, while identifying opportunities to retire technical debt and modernize along the way.

You'll tackle challenges around deliverability, throughput, sender reputation, and compliance — problems where good engineering decisions have measurable business impact. You'll collaborate closely with product, deliverability specialists, and other engineering teams. We're a remote-first team that values clear communication, pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping work that matters.

**Here is more of what you’ll get to do:**

* Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across our email and communications platform
* Work on systems that handle email delivery at scale — sending infrastructure, queue management, throttling, bounce handling, and deliverability optimization
* Build and improve APIs, background services, and data pipelines in .NET
* Develop and maintain cloud-native services in Azure (Functions, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, SQL, Blob Storage, etc.)

**Senior Software Engineer, Java- Site Reliability**

**About the Role**

NinjaOne is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who enjoys both building software and making sure it runs reliably at scale. You’ll develop Java and Kotlin services for our IT Operations product suite, then help those services perform well in production as NinjaOne grows. Providing clean and optimized coding solutions, you’ll work to develop high quality software applications that exceed our customers’ expectations – seriously our customers love our products.

Our systems help customers administer, protect, and maintain millions of endpoints and servers worldwide. In this role, you’ll work on product improvements and the reliability challenges that come with operating a large-scale cloud service: performance, scalability, observability, and recovery when things go wrong. You’ll work closely with other engineers to solve problems in the code and improve how we run it.

We are engineers, technology leaders and experts. We create and deliver mission critical services to enable NinjaOne’s customers to administer, protect and maintain millions of endpoints and servers. You will have the opportunity to design and develop high-availability mission critical software systems that support our worldwide operations.

**Location** - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - **CA**, **CO**, **CT**, **FL**, **GA**, **\*IL**, **KS**, **MA**, **MD, ME**, **NJ**, **NC**, **NY**, **OR**, **OH, TN**, **TX**, **VA**, and **WA**. We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option.

We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on **Java**, **Kotlin**, **C++**, **Golang** and **Postgres**; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in **AWS**. Experience with large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design, and client-server architecture will help you succeed here.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* **Build and improve software:** Design, develop, test, and ship Java and Kotlin services and product improvements used at large scale.
* **Own reliability in production:** Investigate performance and availability issues, identify their causes, and make lasting improvements to the services you help build.
* **Improve scalability:** Find bottlenecks in application code, data access, and service interactions; design changes that let our systems grow reliably.
* **Make systems easier to operate:** Improve the visibility engineers have into service health, so problems can be detected, understood, and resolved more effectively.
* **Work across the full life of a service:** Contribute to design decisions, code reviews, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting alongside your fellow engineers.
* Perform other duties as needed.

**About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience.
* 10+ years of Java software development experience for product applications, or equivalent experience. Strong Kotlin experience will make you a standout candidate.
* 4+ years of experience working with highly scalable software systems.
* Experience diagnosing and improving the reliability, performance, and scalability of services in production.
* Strong object-oriented design skills and experience applying design principles to complex software systems.
* Knowledge of API best practices and REST service development using frameworks such as Jersey or Spring.
* Relational database design and development experience, including experience identifying and addressing data access bottlenecks.
* Experience with asynchronous application design and client-server communication.
* Experience troubleshooting production systems and participating in incident response.
* Strong testing practices and a commitment to building software that is dependable in production.
* Experience with caching systems, especially Redis, will make you a standout candidate.
* Python experience is a plus.

**About Us**

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for more than 40,000 customers in 140+ countries. The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

**What You’ll Love**

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

* Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

You're the highest technical authority within the area, and accountable for both its technical outcomes and the continuous improvement of its engineering quality. Together with the area's Director of Engineering, you share accountability for the area's customer and business outcomes — the OKRs and KPIs the business plans on, what the area ships, and how reliably it serves customers.

You're motivated to own mission-critical systems — the ones where correctness, data integrity, security, and availability are obligations, not features, and where a defect in production affects real customers moving real money. The weight of that responsibility is part of what draws you to this role, not something you tolerate.

You're hands-on. Still. You lead by example — your quality, your work ethic, your AI-native practice, and your engineering judgment set what the area looks like at its best.

When the area hits its highest-stakes moments — incidents that draw executive attention, senior cross-functional escalations, the most critical delivery moments — you're in the room and on point. You show up, take the lead, and stay on it until it's resolved — regardless of time of day, day of week, or weekend.

You participate in the Architecture Review Board and the Principal Engineering & Architecture Guild. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

**Location**
------------

This role is fully remote in Canada

**About the job you are considering**
-------------------------------------

We're looking for a senior backend engineer to help design, migrate, and operate the power ingestion, processing, storage, and lifecycle management of user- and listing-generated media (images, video, and documents) across our platform. This role sits at the intersection of platform migration, data compliance, and service reliability — you'll own multi-quarter modernization efforts while ensuring the pipeline meets strict privacy and trust requirements.

**Your role**
-------------

* Drive platform migrations end-to-end — design and execute the migration of legacy media-processing services onto a modern replacement platform, including data-model design, dual-write/backfill strategies, phased cutovers, and legacy cleanup.
* Build event-driven processing pipelines — design Kafka/event-schema-based consumers and producers to power asynchronous media-processing workflows (state machines, checkpoints, retries, idempotency guarantees).
* Own trust & privacy compliance in the data path — implement GDPR-compliant hard-deletion workflows across storage and CDN layers, integrate personal-data-detection and content-integrity checks into upload/creation flows, and build safe-content transformation pipelines for user-uploaded files.
* Integrate third-party media infrastructure — build and maintain integrations with external transcoding/processing vendors, including webhook handling, rate limiting, and failure handling.
* Ensure operational excellence — write on-call runbooks and alerting for critical endpoints, manage service-mesh permissions between internal services, tune consumer/throughput settings, and resolve reliability issues (memory, latency, backpressure).
* Evolve core data models and APIs — design and extend database schemas and GraphQL/API layers supporting media entities, with a focus on idempotency, consistency, and backward compatibility during migrations.
* Partner cross-functionally — work with trust & safety, privacy, and adjacent platform teams to translate compliance and product requirements into pipeline changes

**Must have skills**
--------------------

* 5+ years of backend software engineering experience, ideally on high-scale distributed systems.
* Strong experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka or equivalent), service meshes, and microservice-to-microservice integration.
* Experience owning large-scale service migrations — designing safe cutover strategies, backfills, and rollback plans.
* Solid grounding in relational/NoSQL data modeling and schema evolution.
* Experience with caching layers (Redis or similar), CDC/change-data-capture pipelines, and cache invalidation strategies.
* Comfort with operational ownership: writing alerts, runbooks, and debugging production incidents.
* Experience with media/video processing pipelines, third-party transcoding vendors, or content-safety systems.

---------------------------

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. We believe the best experiences come from teams who care deeply about the people they build for, and each other.

* Own backend reliability and platform health, including staging, CI/CD, databases, queues, cost, and observability.
* Raise the ceiling for the team through PR review, mentorship, pairing, and by setting a high bar on design, testing, and ops.
* Be the Everand backend voice in cross-team planning, and the glue in cross-functional execution.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence while driving scalable, resilient, and observable systems that let teams move fast, simplify complexity, and deliver with confidence.
* Modernize legacy systems and eliminate technical debt to improve velocity and scalability.
* Partner with Product, Design, Analytics, and Web, Mobile, and ML Engineers to deliver backend systems that support experimentation and a single source of truth across platforms, using data, metrics, and telemetry to uncover trends, resolve anomalies, and guide the team with clarity and foresight.
* Champion a user-first mindset, grounding technical decisions in how they enhance the reading and listening experience.

**We’re excited about you because…**

* You bring significant experience in backend engineering, with a strong track record building and scaling distributed systems.
* You write clean, maintainable, and secure code in at least one modern backend language such as Ruby (preferred), Scala, Go, or Python.
* You have a keen eye for reliability and observability, and care about defining SLOs, implementing metrics and alerts, and debugging distributed systems.
* You have a proven track record of technical leadership: setting architectural direction, mentoring engineers, and driving large-scale migrations or modernization efforts.
* You thrive in cross-functional collaboration, holding your own with senior PM, design, and ML partners, and caring more about the system landing well than about being right.
* You enjoy mentoring, knowledge-sharing, and contributing to cross-team initiatives, including architecture review groups and design discussions that shape Scribd, Inc.'s engineering culture.
* You care deeply about the users; understanding what makes Everand impactful in their daily lives and translating that empathy into the systems you build.

* Strong coding ability in Ruby.

* Experience working alongside ML teams on recommendation or feed systems.

jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 393197
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Senior AWS Integration Developer - Remote to join our team in Halifax, Nova Scotia (CA-NS), Canada (CA).
  
  
Senior AWS Integration Developer
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking a Senior AWS Integration Developer to design, develop, and support modern, enterprise-scale integration solutions across cloud, on-premises, and third-party applications.
  
  
This is a hands-on development role for an experienced integration engineer who is passionate about AWS, serverless architecture, APIs, event-driven integration, and modern software development. You will work with technologies including Python, C#/.NET, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, S3, DynamoDB, and CloudWatch to build secure, scalable, and highly reliable integration services.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring strong software engineering fundamentals, experience solving complex integration challenges, and the ability to work collaboratively with architects, developers, business analysts, and application teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade integration solutions using Python and C#/.NET.
* Build serverless and event-driven architectures using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, and SNS.
* Design and develop REST APIs, microservices, and integration services connecting cloud, on-premises, and third-party applications.
* Develop reliable, scalable workflows for data movement, application integration, orchestration, and business process automation.
* Integrate enterprise applications and business platforms through secure, well-designed APIs and services.
* Apply software engineering best practices around code quality, security, scalability, resiliency, observability, and performance.
* Implement logging, monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting using Amazon CloudWatch and related AWS services.
* Diagnose and resolve complex integration, application, and production issues.
* Optimize existing integrations for performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, infrastructure automation, and DevOps practices.
* Participate in architecture and technical design discussions and help identify opportunities to modernize legacy integration patterns.
* Work closely with solution architects, business analysts, developers, infrastructure teams, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other developers and contribute to development standards and best practices.

Required Qualifications
  

* 10+ years of professional software development and integration experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Python and C#/.NET development.
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS development experience, including significant experience with:
* AWS Lambda
* AWS Step Functions
* API Gateway
* EventBridge
* SQS and SNS
* S3
* DynamoDB
* CloudWatch
* Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs and microservices.
* Demonstrated experience building serverless and event-driven integration solutions.
* Experience integrating cloud, on-premises, and third-party applications.
* Strong understanding of integration patterns, API design, asynchronous messaging, workflow orchestration, and distributed systems.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated deployments, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or similar software development environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* AWS Certified Developer – Associate/Professional or AWS Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional certification.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
* Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
* Knowledge of API security, OAuth 2.0, JWT, IAM, and enterprise security practices.
* Experience with automated testing and test-driven development.
* Experience modernizing legacy integrations into cloud-native and serverless architectures.
* Experience with enterprise integration platforms, messaging systems, or API management solutions.

Why Join This Team?
  
  
This is an opportunity to play a key role in building modern, cloud-native integration capabilities within an enterprise environment. You will work on meaningful integration challenges, leverage some of AWS's most powerful serverless and event-driven technologies, and have the opportunity to influence how applications and platforms connect across the organization.
  
  
If you are a senior software engineer who enjoys solving complex integration problems, building scalable AWS solutions, and working with modern cloud technologies, we'd like to hear from you.
  
  
Pay Transparency
  
  
Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $92,408-$171,125. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.
  
  
This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and ADD insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits

new_jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer, Email & Communications Platform (Software Engineer III)**

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team that owns our email and communications platform — the system responsible for delivering millions of marketing emails on behalf of our dealer network. You'll work across the full stack, building and scaling the infrastructure that powers campaigns, transactional messages, and automated communications that directly drive revenue for our customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. Our platform is in an active modernization phase. You'll be working in a mature codebase that serves real production traffic while incrementally upgrading architecture, tooling, and patterns. That means you need to be comfortable holding two things at once: keeping the lights on for a system dealers depend on today, and making deliberate progress toward where the platform needs to be tomorrow. You'll design and implement features end-to-end, from database schema and API design through to the UI that internal teams and dealers interact with, while identifying opportunities to retire technical debt and modernize along the way.

You'll tackle challenges around deliverability, throughput, sender reputation, and compliance — problems where good engineering decisions have measurable business impact. You'll collaborate closely with product, deliverability specialists, and other engineering teams. ---------------------------

Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. As a **Staff Software Engineer on the Everand Core team**, you’ll help shape the future of how people discover, organize, and enjoy books. Everand is growing, and we’re evolving our reading and listening experiences to make stories more accessible, personal, and engaging for our readers.

You'll play a vital role in connecting readers with the stories they love by owning the backend platform that powers Everand's web and mobile experiences. This includes everything from rapid experimentation to the services driving discoverability, personalization, and our core consumption journeys. You'll work closely with engineers across search, recommendations, web, and mobile, as well as design and product partners, to align technical decisions with user needs and platform capabilities. Along the way, you'll build systems that drive performance, personalization, and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of our backend team.

* Foster a culture of technical excellence while driving scalable, resilient, and observable systems that let teams move fast, simplify complexity, and deliver with confidence.
* Modernize legacy systems and eliminate technical debt to improve velocity and scalability.
* Partner with Product, Design, Analytics, and Web, Mobile, and ML Engineers to deliver backend systems that support experimentation and a single source of truth across platforms, using data, metrics, and telemetry to uncover trends, resolve anomalies, and guide the team with clarity and foresight.
* Champion a user-first mindset, grounding technical decisions in how they enhance the reading and listening experience.

* You bring significant experience in backend engineering, with a strong track record building and scaling distributed systems.
* You write clean, maintainable, and secure code in at least one modern backend language such as Ruby (preferred), Scala, Go, or Python.
* You have a keen eye for reliability and observability, and care about defining SLOs, implementing metrics and alerts, and debugging distributed systems.
* You have a proven track record of technical leadership: setting architectural direction, mentoring engineers, and driving large-scale migrations or modernization efforts.

* You enjoy mentoring, knowledge-sharing, and contributing to cross-team initiatives, including architecture review groups and design discussions that shape Scribd, Inc.'s engineering culture.
* You care deeply about the users; understanding what makes Everand impactful in their daily lives and translating that empathy into the systems you build.

* Strong coding ability in Ruby.
* Experience improving reliability, latency, or throughput in large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience working alongside ML teams on recommendation or feed systems.
* Familiarity with experimentation or feature-flagging platforms.
